documents.title: 14 May extension and edit window notice

evidenceNotes: Original detailed advertisement page 1 states 12 Principal positions in District Institute of Education and Training under West Bengal School Education Department, applications planned 30 April–21 May 2026 through 15:00.

Signed 14 May extension says applications did not begin 30 April due to technical glitches; actual opening date is not supplied. Application and fee deadline moved to 3 June at 15:00. Separate edit window moved to 7–12 June through 15:00 and is not a fresh application period.

Original PDF invites Indian citizens and others declared eligible by Government of India; no list of eligible foreign citizenship classes appears. Do not treat all non-Indian citizens as accepted or excluded.

Principal-specific qualifications require a regular two-year master's in school teaching subject with honours at graduation and 55%; M.Ed/M.Ed Elementary with 55%, or MA Education with 55% plus Primary/Elementary diploma/degree with 55%; five years teaching in Primary/Elementary Teachers' Training Institute; Bengali spoken/written and computer literacy. General Bengali rule includes Nepali mother tongue exception unless specifically mentioned; principal-specific Bengali clause requires founder/authority reconciliation. No CEFR level given.

Age limit is 42 on 1 January 2026, with state-specific SC/ST, OBC and disability exceptions. Model cannot safely apply those relaxations without category domicile proof, so upper age is a manual check rather than a blanket automatic rejection.
One advertised post type and application cycle covers 12 positions; homepage and announcement archive both retain notice links. No examination venue is published.
